perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals

factors.name: financingCapacity
factors.basis: Nebius announced a $775 million senior secured facility backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows, with the company stating the facility plus customer cash flows covers more than 100% of capex for the underlying deployment.

risks: Secured financing encumbers underlying infrastructure and introduces SOFR-linked debt service.
unknowns: The announcement does not establish returns on future deployments outside the financed customer package.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: contractBackedBuildout
factors.basis: The July 17 financing is tied to an investment-grade customer agreement and deployed GPU infrastructure, providing source-addressed evidence that at least one expansion package has contracted cash-flow support rather than being purely speculative capacity build.

risks: Execution still depends on deployment timing, GPU availability, power and customer performance.
unknowns: No independent evidence in this bounded search quantified realized margins from the financed capacity.

facts: Nebius entered a senior secured debt facility of approximately $775 million.
The facility matures October 31, 2030 and is priced at SOFR plus 2.50%.
It is backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows from an investment-grade customer.
Nebius states the facility plus customer cash flows covers more than 100% of capex required for the underlying GPU deployment.

result: New financing/capex-coverage evidence added for Alpha; no numeric score judgment made.
